sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集最初作为付费订阅者的早期福利，发布在Casefile的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道上。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集篇幅较短，旨在让我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 如需抢先收听这些无广告剧集，您可以在您偏好的平台上支持Casefile。

sentences.en: In 1999, married couple Ina and David Steiner launched Auction Bytes, an e-newsletter catering to those whose business was selling items online.
sentences.zh: 1999年，艾娜·斯坦纳和戴维·斯坦纳夫妇创办了“Auction Bytes”，这是一份专门为在线卖家提供资讯的电子通讯。

sentences.en: The idea originated from the Steiner's shared interest in collecting and trading.
sentences.zh: 这个想法源于斯坦纳夫妇对收藏和交易的共同兴趣。

sentences.en: Ina had amassed a large collection of books, and, ever since childhood, her husband David had been a frequenter of yard sales, always on the lookout for antiques.
sentences.zh: 艾娜收藏了大量书籍，而她的丈夫戴维自幼就经常光顾庭院旧货甩卖，总是在寻找古董。

sentences.en: The Steiner's prided themselves on factually reporting the latest industry news, and keeping readers up to date and informed on the inner workings of various online marketplaces.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳夫妇以如实报道最新的行业新闻为荣，并致力于让读者随时了解各大在线市场的内部运作情况。

sentences.en: Ina did most of the writing, while David focused on the publication side of things.
sentences.zh: 艾娜负责大部分撰稿工作，而戴维则专注于出版事务。

sentences.en: Although their newsletter began in the early days of internet commerce,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们的通讯起步于互联网商业的早期，

sentences.en: it filled a niche and grew in popularity as online trading became an important tool for businesses worldwide.
sentences.zh: 但它填补了市场空白，并随着在线交易成为全球企业的重要工具而日益普及。

sentences.en: The Steiner's eventually changed their publication's name to e-commerce bytes, and by 2019, it was a valued and reputable resource for sellers on a number of online platforms,
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳夫妇最终将刊物名称改为“e-commerce bytes”。到2019年，它已成为众多在线平台卖家眼中极具价值和声望的资源，

sentences.en: including Craigslist, Etsy, Amazon, and eBay.
sentences.zh: 包括Craigslist、Etsy、亚马逊和eBay。

sentences.en: From her home in the town of Natick, Massachusetts, Ina published daily articles such as,
sentences.zh: 艾娜在马萨诸塞州内蒂克的家中，每天发布诸如以下文章：

sentences.en: What is behind Amazon Prime shipping delays?
sentences.zh: 亚马逊Prime配送延迟背后的原因是什么？

sentences.en: And Craigslist finally launches a mobile app, worth the wait.
sentences.zh: Craigslist终于推出了移动应用，值得等待吗？

sentences.en: Ina also managed the e-commerce bytes' social media accounts, which allowed her to directly engage with her small but passionate community.
sentences.zh: 艾娜还负责管理“e-commerce bytes”的社交媒体账号，这让她能够直接与她那规模虽小但充满热情的社区进行互动。

sentences.en: On Thursday, August 1, 2019,
sentences.zh: 2019年8月1日，星期四，

sentences.en: the New York Times published an article detailing a lawsuit that US multinational e-commerce company eBay had recently filed against their direct competitor, Amazon.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》发表了一篇文章，详细报道了美国跨国电商公司eBay最近对其直接竞争对手亚马逊提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: eBay was accusing Amazon of unlawfully poaching their sellers.
sentences.zh: eBay指控亚马逊非法挖走他们的卖家。

sentences.en: eBay's CEO, Devin Wenig, has been unable to stop a decline in market sales, but trying to dissuade sellers from turning to Amazon,
sentences.zh: eBay首席执行官德文·温尼格一直无法阻止市场销售额的下滑，但试图劝阻卖家不要转向亚马逊，

sentences.en: and trying to get Amazon to stop recruiting sellers, may not be the best tactic.
sentences.zh: 以及试图让亚马逊停止招募卖家，可能并不是最好的策略。

sentences.en: Days later, on Wednesday August 7, the e-commerce bytes' Twitter account received a private message from a user Ina didn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 几天后的8月7日，星期三，“e-commerce bytes”的Twitter账号收到了一条来自艾娜不认识的用户的私信。

sentences.en: Their username was Tui Alei, and their profile picture was an image of a skull surrounded by darkness.
sentences.zh: 他们的用户名是“Tui Alei”，头像是一张被黑暗包围的骷髅图片。

sentences.en: They asked what Ina's problem was with eBay.
sentences.zh: 他们问艾娜对eBay有什么不满。

sentences.en: Based on their Twitter bio, it appeared Tui Alei was an eBay seller based in Samoa, who was new to Twitter, with no post history and no followers.
sentences.zh: 根据Twitter简介，Tui Alei似乎是一位居住在萨摩亚的eBay卖家，刚注册Twitter，没有发布历史，也没有粉丝。

sentences.en: Ina suspected they were a troll, an online provocator who typically posted offensive content behind nameless accounts to arouse an emotional response in others.
sentences.zh: 艾娜怀疑对方是“网络喷子”，即那种通常躲在匿名账号后发布冒犯性内容，以激起他人情绪反应的网络挑衅者。

sentences.en: The best way to deal with the troll was not to respond to them at all, so Ina ignored Tui Alei's message.
sentences.zh: 对付喷子最好的办法就是完全不予理睬，所以艾娜忽略了Tui Alei的消息。

sentences.en: This only fuelled their anger.
sentences.zh: 这反而助长了对方的怒火。

sentences.en: They sent Ina a stream of messages that read,
sentences.zh: 他们向艾娜发送了一连串消息，内容写道：

sentences.en: Aina continued to ignore Tui Alei, adhering to the old internet adage,
sentences.zh: 艾娜继续无视Tui Alei，坚持互联网上的那句老话：

sentences.en: Don't feed the trolls.
sentences.zh: 不要喂食喷子。

sentences.en: By refusing to reply, Ina hoped Tui Alei would grow bored and move on.
sentences.zh: 通过拒绝回复，艾娜希望Tui Alei会感到无趣而离开。

sentences.en: But they didn't.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有。

sentences.en: They continued to message Ina, their tone growing increasingly hostile.
sentences.zh: 他们继续给艾娜发消息，语气变得越来越充满敌意。

sentences.en: You don't have the balls to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 你根本没胆子跟我说话。

sentences.en: Stop hiding behind your computer screen, you fucking cunt.
sentences.zh: 别躲在电脑屏幕后面了，你这个该死的婊子。

sentences.en: Still, Ina wouldn't engage.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，艾娜依然没有理会。

sentences.en: Then, late the following night of Thursday August 8, over the course of one hour,
sentences.zh: 随后，在第二天深夜，即8月8日星期四，在一小时内，

sentences.en: Ina's email inbox was flooded with more than 50 email and newsletter subscriptions that she had not signed up for.
sentences.zh: 艾娜的电子邮箱被50多封她从未订阅过的邮件和通讯塞满了。

sentences.en: Some were from ideological groups she had no interest in, like the Communist Party, the Satanic Temple, and Scientology.
sentences.zh: 其中一些来自她毫无兴趣的意识形态团体，比如共产党、撒旦圣殿和科学教派。

sentences.en: Others featured disconcerting content relating to bondage, cadavers, and animal abuse.
sentences.zh: 另一些则包含令人不安的内容，涉及捆绑、尸体和虐待动物。

sentences.en: Two days later, Ina's husband, David, received a bizarre and somewhat chilling email.
sentences.zh: 两天后，艾娜的丈夫戴维收到了一封离奇且令人毛骨悚然的邮件。

sentences.en: It reported that a preserved fetal pig had been ordered online and was being sent to the Steiner's home.
sentences.zh: 邮件称，有人在网上订购了一具保存完好的胎猪标本，正寄往斯坦纳夫妇的家中。

sentences.en: At around 4pm, a package arrived from Amazon that was addressed to Ina.
sentences.zh: 下午4点左右，一个寄给艾娜的亚马逊包裹送达了。

sentences.en: It contained a Halloween mask depicting a bloody pig face, similar to one worn by the Jigsaw Killer and his accomplices in the horror film franchise, Soar.
sentences.zh: 里面是一个万圣节面具，描绘了一张血淋淋的猪脸，类似于恐怖电影系列《电锯惊魂》中“竖锯”及其同伙所戴的面具。

sentences.en: Fifteen minutes later, Ina received a notification for the e-commerce by its Twitter account.
sentences.zh: 十五分钟后，艾娜收到了“e-commerce bytes”Twitter账号的通知。

sentences.en: It was a new private message from Tui Ale that read,
sentences.zh: 那是一条来自Tui Ale的新私信，写道：

sentences.en: Do I have your attention now?
sentences.zh: 现在你注意到我了吗？

sentences.en: Ina did not seek out an explanation for Tui Ale's abusive behaviour.
sentences.zh: 艾娜并没有去寻求Tui Ale这种辱骂行为的解释。

sentences.en: It seemed her online harasser knew where she lived and she didn't want to provoke them further.
sentences.zh: 看起来这个网络骚扰者知道她住在哪里，她不想进一步激怒对方。

sentences.en: Ina maintained her silence, still hoping it would succeed as a deterrent.
sentences.zh: 艾娜保持沉默，仍希望这能起到威慑作用。

sentences.en: But Tui Ale continued to bombard her with messages like,
sentences.zh: 但Tui Ale继续用各种消息轰炸她，例如：

sentences.en: You're a fat fuck pussy.
sentences.zh: 你这个肥胖的蠢货。

sentences.en: David needs to put you in line, cunt.
sentences.zh: 戴维该好好管教你了，婊子。

sentences.en: A day later, David Steiner was sent an Amazon package of his own.
sentences.zh: 一天后，戴维·斯坦纳也收到了一个亚马逊包裹。

sentences.en: It contained a book titled,
sentences.zh: 里面是一本书，书名为：

sentences.en: Grief Diaries, Surviving the Loss of a Spouse.
sentences.zh: 《悲伤日记：在丧偶后幸存》。

sentences.en: Two ELA sent more messages to Ina throughout the day, repeatedly demanding to know what her problem was with eBay.
sentences.zh: Two ELA整天都在给艾娜发更多消息，反复要求知道她对eBay有什么不满。

sentences.en: The truth was that Ina didn't have one.
sentences.zh: 事实是，艾娜根本没有任何不满。

sentences.en: Sure, she had written an article about the company's lawsuit with Amazon that could be interpreted as critical, but it was hardly scathing or destructive.
sentences.zh: 诚然，她写过一篇关于该公司与亚马逊诉讼的文章，内容可能被解读为批评，但那绝非尖刻或具有破坏性。

sentences.en: And although it wasn't the first time she'd scrutinised eBay's business practices,
sentences.zh: 虽然这不是她第一次审视eBay的商业行为，

sentences.en: she afforded them the same degree of respectful critique that she gave every company she wrote about.
sentences.zh: 但她给予了他们与她所报道的每家公司同等程度的尊重性批评。

sentences.en: Earlier that year, she had reported positively on eBay's promise to give sellers greater protection.
sentences.zh: 那年早些时候，她还曾积极报道过eBay给予卖家更大保护的承诺。

sentences.en: It was bizarre to think someone would go to such lengths to punish her for holding a rather mild and inconsequential opinion.
sentences.zh: 很难想象有人会为了惩罚她发表一个相当温和且无关紧要的观点而做出如此过激的行为。

sentences.en: Ina refused to engage Two ELA in any discourse, believing the person behind the username must be unwell.
sentences.zh: 艾娜拒绝与Two ELA进行任何交流，认为这个用户名背后的人一定精神不正常。

sentences.en: Then, on Tuesday August 13, almost a week after Two ELA's harassment began,
sentences.zh: 接着，在8月13日星期二，即Two ELA的骚扰开始近一周后，

sentences.en: David Steiner received a voicemail from a representative at Adam and Eve, a US company that sells adult toys online.
sentences.zh: 戴维·斯坦纳收到了一份来自“Adam and Eve”代表的语音留言，这是一家在线销售成人用品的美国公司。

sentences.en: They were responding to David's purported interest in opening a franchise store.
sentences.zh: 他们是在回应戴维所谓的开设特许经营店的意向。

sentences.en: Neither David nor Ina had expressed any interest in such an endeavour.
sentences.zh: 戴维和艾娜从未表达过任何此类意向。

sentences.en: That same day, Two ELA tweeted e-commerce bites, asking,
sentences.zh: 同一天，Two ELA在Twitter上艾特“e-commerce bytes”，问道：

sentences.en: Are you there?
sentences.zh: 你在吗？

sentences.en: Why won't you answer me?
sentences.zh: 为什么不回答我？

sentences.en: Many families, including mine, make money to pay for food, clothes and rent by selling on eBay.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭，包括我的家庭，都是靠在eBay上卖东西赚钱来支付食物、衣服和房租的。

sentences.en: Your stupid idiot comments are pushing buyers away from eBay and hurting families.
sentences.zh: 你那些愚蠢的评论正在把买家从eBay推开，伤害了这些家庭。

sentences.en: Stop it now.
sentences.zh: 马上停止。

sentences.en: These messages only served to further confuse Ina and David.
sentences.zh: 这些消息只会让艾娜和戴维更加困惑。

sentences.en: At the time, eBay was ranked in the 200s in Fortune 500, an annual list of the 500 largest US industrial corporations as measured by gross income.
sentences.zh: 当时，eBay在《财富》500强中排名200多位，这是一份按总收入衡量的美国500家最大工业企业年度榜单。

sentences.en: The company had a market value of over $47 billion and employed 13,000 people worldwide.
sentences.zh: 该公司市值超过470亿美元，在全球拥有13,000名员工。

sentences.en: It was completely unreasonable to think Ina's non-partisan commentary in her niche corner of the internet could impact such an industry powerhouse.
sentences.zh: 认为艾娜在互联网小众角落发表的非党派评论能影响这样一个行业巨头，是完全不合理的。

sentences.en: Even if it did, shouldn't the contempt be directed at eBay itself?
sentences.zh: 即使真的有影响，难道不应该对eBay本身表示不满吗？

sentences.en: Ina was only reporting the facts.
sentences.zh: 艾娜只是在报道事实。

sentences.en: If the business was faltering, then the solution would be fixing its probleMs.
sentences.zh: 如果企业经营不善，那么解决办法应该是修复其问题。

sentences.en: Silencing Ina might go some way to improving public perception of the company, but it wouldn't resolve the actual issues sellers were facing.
sentences.zh: 让艾娜闭嘴或许能在一定程度上改善公众对该公司的看法，但这并不能解决卖家面临的实际问题。

sentences.en: 2ELA's idiot comments remark was particularly strange, as the Steiners carried themselves like respected journalists.
sentences.zh: 2ELA提到的“愚蠢评论”非常奇怪，因为斯坦纳夫妇一直表现得像受人尊敬的记者。

sentences.en: They didn't get involved in frivolous or petty internet drama.
sentences.zh: 他们从不参与轻浮或琐碎的网络闹剧。

sentences.en: The next day, the Steiners received a package from Carolina Biological Supply, a company based in North Carolina that sold science-related products.
sentences.zh: 第二天，斯坦纳夫妇收到了一个来自“Carolina Biological Supply”的包裹，这是一家位于北卡罗来纳州、销售科学相关产品的公司。

sentences.en: They opened it and were alarmed to discover it contained fly larvae and live spiders.
sentences.zh: 他们打开后惊恐地发现里面装的是蝇蛆和活蜘蛛。

sentences.en: A second package arrived that same day, this one from an insect supply company based in Kansas.
sentences.zh: 当天又送达了第二个包裹，来自堪萨斯州的一家昆虫供应公司。

sentences.en: It held live cockroaches.
sentences.zh: 里面装的是活蟑螂。

sentences.en: 2ELA tweeted the couple,
sentences.zh: 2ELA在Twitter上对这对夫妇说：

sentences.en: Ina, when you hurt our business, you hurt our families.
sentences.zh: 艾娜，当你伤害我们的生意时，你就是在伤害我们的家庭。

sentences.en: People will do anything to protect family.
sentences.zh: 为了保护家人，人们什么事都做得出来。

sentences.en: Ina and David were rattled.
sentences.zh: 艾娜和戴维感到心惊胆战。

sentences.en: With no idea who was behind the 2ELA account, the couple began increasing their security measures.
sentences.zh: 由于不知道2ELA账号背后是谁，这对夫妇开始加强安保措施。

sentences.en: They installed video cameras outside their home, added some battery-powered alarms, and reported the harassment to the Natick Police Department,
sentences.zh: 他们在屋外安装了摄像头，增加了一些电池供电的警报器，并向内蒂克警察局报告了骚扰事件，

sentences.en: which agreed to conduct patrols of the couple's home.
sentences.zh: 警方同意对这对夫妇的住所进行巡逻。

sentences.en: The following day, the Steiners were mortified to learn that two of their neighbours had received packages with David's name on them that contained, quote,
sentences.zh: 第二天，斯坦纳夫妇震惊地得知，他们的两名邻居收到了写有戴维名字的包裹，里面装的是，引用原话：

sentences.en: barely legal pornography.
sentences.zh: “勉强合法的色情制品”。

sentences.en: Later that day, a florist dropped off an ominous funeral wreath with a card that featured Ina's name.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，一名花店员工送来了一个不祥的葬礼花圈，卡片上写着艾娜的名字。

sentences.en: This marked the couple's second death-themed delivery.
sentences.zh: 这标志着这对夫妇收到的第二次以死亡为主题的快递。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集赞助商的内容来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Steiners had noticed a black Dodge minivan with New York licence plates circling their neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，斯坦纳夫妇注意到一辆挂着纽约车牌的黑色道奇小型货车在他们社区周围盘旋。

sentences.en: David sensed the vehicle was following him and felt certain he was going to be killed.
sentences.zh: 戴维感觉到这辆车在跟踪他，并确信自己会被杀害。

sentences.en: He took note of the minivan's licence plate and reported it to police.
sentences.zh: 他记下了这辆小型货车的车牌号并报告给了警方。

sentences.en: Officers searched for the vehicle in their databases, but nothing came up that corresponded with the information provided by the Steiners.
sentences.zh: 警官在数据库中搜索了该车辆，但没有发现与斯坦纳夫妇提供的信息相符的记录。

sentences.en: They nevertheless put out a call on police radio to be on the lookout for the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们还是在警用无线电中发布了寻找该车辆的通告。

sentences.en: It wasn't sighted again.
sentences.zh: 此后再也没有人见到过它。

sentences.en: That evening, an emergency plumber was sent to the Steiners' home.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，一名紧急管道工被派往斯坦纳夫妇家中。

sentences.en: At 4.30am the following night, a black car stopped outside their house.

sentences.zh: 2021年，斯坦纳夫妇对eBay、刑事案件中的七名被告以及包括德文·温尼格和史蒂夫·怀默在内的其他几个相关方提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: Although the two former eBay VIPs had denied involvement in or knowledge of the crimes committed against the Steiners, the couple suspected this wasn't entirely true.
sentences.zh: 尽管这两位eBay前高管否认参与或知晓针对斯坦纳夫妇的犯罪行为，但这对夫妇怀疑这并非完全属实。

sentences.en: Forensic copies of Steve Weimer's personal and company cell phones showed that communications from August 2019 were missing, leading authorities to believe they were deleted.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·怀默个人和公司手机的法医副本显示，2019年8月的通讯记录丢失，导致当局认为它们已被删除。

sentences.en: However, records recovered from other participants' devices showed that multiple text messages and emails were sent to Steve Weimer, informing him about some of their activities.
sentences.zh: 然而，从其他参与者设备中恢复的记录显示，多条短信和电子邮件被发送给史蒂夫·怀默，告知他关于他们的一些活动。

sentences.en: When one conspirator emailed Steve to tell him the police were investigating eBay,
sentences.zh: 当一名共谋者发邮件告诉史蒂夫警方正在调查eBay时，

sentences.en: Steve replied,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫回复道：

sentences.en: Please do not do anything until I can check a few things.
sentences.zh: 在我核实一些事情之前，请不要做任何事。

sentences.en: I don't want us to engage.
sentences.zh: 我不想让我们卷入其中。

sentences.en: The Steiners believed that Steve Weimer at least should have been indicted for obstructing justice, destroying evidence, and misleading an investigation.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳夫妇认为，史蒂夫·怀默至少应该因妨碍司法、销毁证据和误导调查而被起诉。

sentences.en: Their attorney stated,
sentences.zh: 他们的律师表示：

sentences.en: I think the federal government is taking the position that they didn't have enough evidence to indict Weimer and other executives.
sentences.zh: 我认为联邦政府的立场是，他们没有足够的证据起诉怀默和其他高管。

sentences.en: Our position is that you can't find the evidence you're not looking for.
sentences.zh: 我们的立场是，你找不到你根本不去寻找的证据。

sentences.en: They just weren't looking.
sentences.zh: 他们只是没去查而已。

sentences.en: The civil proceedings are still underway as of June 2024.
sentences.zh: 截至2024年6月，民事诉讼仍在进行中。

sentences.en: As a result of the harassment,
sentences.zh: 由于骚扰的结果，

sentences.en: Ina and David suffered permanent psychological trauma and significant economic damage.
sentences.zh: 艾娜和大卫遭受了永久性的心理创伤和重大的经济损失。

sentences.en: Despite this, the Steiners continue to publish e-commerce bites and still report on news pertaining to eBay.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，斯坦纳夫妇继续发布电子商务资讯，并仍在报道与eBay相关的新闻。

sentences.en: While they never made any public statements in the aftermath of the harassment,
sentences.zh: 虽然他们在骚扰事件发生后从未发表过任何公开声明，

sentences.en: Ina wrote a number of articles on the case, maintaining her trademark fact-based and unbiased reporting, with no personal opinions provided.
sentences.zh: 艾娜撰写了多篇关于此案的文章，保持了她标志性的基于事实和公正的报道风格，没有提供任何个人观点。
